author: Cryomancies
body:
Accused: idozoslime
For: (slowfall?), Anti-knockback, Kill aura, Rapid fire
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-DF3SbK-s_E&feature=youtu.be
Skip to 0:48 and watch onward from there, the hacking should be really obvious.
Take on note that there is a similar account called idozolax9, which got banned for kill aura today, so he might have numerous alts.
idozoslime was also formerly known as idozolax7, so they are most likely linked.
